title: SelectArena: A Modern Benchmark for Feature Selection on Real-world Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.13644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selecting a subset of features (columns) from a tabular dataset is a ubiquitous challenge in real-world applications. Industry experts seek to minimize model training costs, climate scientists require an interpretable subset of factors to understand extreme weather events, and clinicians need to choose among diagnostic tests due to financial and time constraints. When looking at the scientific literature to determine which feature selection method to use, practitioners across domains face an unrepresentative landscape of benchmarking. Despite extensive research, existing feature selection benchmarks provide limited guidance because they rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, or artificially generated data that do not reflect real-world problems. translated_title: SelectArena：面向真实世界表格数据的现代特征选择基准测试
translated_abstract: 从表格数据集中选择特征子集（列）是现实应用中普遍存在的挑战。行业专家希望最小化模型训练成本，气候科学家需要可解释的因素子集来理解极端天气事件，而临床医生由于财务和时间限制需要在各类诊断测试中做出选择。当从业者查阅科学文献以确定应使用哪种特征选择方法时，他们面对的是一个缺乏代表性的基准测试现状。尽管相关研究众多，现有的特征选择基准测试所能提供的指导却十分有限，因为它们依赖于过时的模型、临时设计的评估协议，或无法反映真实问题的人工生成数据。为了弥合科学基准测试与现实应用之间的差距，我们推出了 SelectArena，一个现代化的特征选择基准测试。我们比较了15种广泛使用的特征选择方法……
tldr: 该论文提出了SelectArena——一个基于真实世界表格数据的现代特征选择基准测试，通过比较15种广泛使用的特征选择方法，弥补了现有基准依赖过时模型、临时评估协议和人工数据而无法指导实际应用的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SelectArena, a modern feature selection benchmark on real-world tabular data that compares 15 widely used methods, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks that rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, and artificial data.
